sources.snippet: Dia2 is a streaming dialogue TTS model created by Nari Labs. The model does not need the entire text to produce the audio, and can start generating as the first few words are given as input. You can condition the output on audio, enabling natural conversations in realtime. We provide model checkpoints (1B, 2B) and inference code to accelerate research. sources.title: Dia2-1B: The Lightweight 1B Model Bringing High-Efficiency LLMs to the ...
sources.snippet: The primary goal of Dia2-1B is to lower the barrier for local LLM deployment on domestic Chinese hardware. By targeting the Ascend NPU series, it offers a streamlined path for developers looking to integrate AI into edge devices or private servers.
